title: sanitize_display called on already-sanitized strings causing double-sanitization
description: In load_startup_data, sanitize_display is called on display_name when inserting into contacts_map (line 206). Later, when building the chat display name, names.join() produces a string from the already-sanitized contact names, and then sanitize_display is called again on the full display string (line 264). Double-sanitization is idempotent for well-formed input but wastes CPU and could theoretically mangle content if a sanitized string contains a pattern that looks like a partial escape (e.g., if a contact name ends with ESC). This is not a security issue but is a code smell that will generate confusion for maintainers about which strings are sanitized at which boundary.
